title: VEXON MED · AD #1 · Gym regular · cut to “Baboon” · Storyboard
music_note: Cut to “Baboon” (Rj Pasin) as used in the reference TikTok: 165 BPM, 3+3+2 accents, drop at 3.007 s. Exported silent.

shots.name: HOOK
shots.note: One boxing take, one sentence. Lines slam in on the song's intro hits (0.10 / 0.46 / 0.83 / 1.19 s); punch-in on the bar at 1.92 s; cut on the drop at 3.01 s.

shots.name: PROBLEM a
shots.text: Working out consistently doesn’t mean every area of your performance is optimized.
shots.note: White flash on the drop (3.01 s). Rowing stroke.

shots.name: PROBLEM b
shots.note: Zoom-blur push on the bar downbeat (4.83 s) into the outdoor machine push. Line holds.

shots.name: STRENGTH
shots.note: Hard hit on the accent (7.01 s). Brackets snap onto the grip device.

shots.name: CARDIO
shots.note: Whip on the bar downbeat (7.73 s). Rings from the VO2 mask.

shots.name: MOBILITY
shots.note: Paper cutout on 8.82 s. Speed ramp into the squat.

shots.name: BALANCE
shots.note: Vertical whip on 9.91 s down to the feet on the force plate.

shots.name: REACTION
shots.note: Zoom-blur on the bar downbeat (10.64 s).

shots.name: QUESTION
shots.text: How do you actually measure up?
shots.note: Zoom punch on 11.73 s into the 3D body scan; slow pull-out, darker grade.

shots.name: SOLUTION a
shots.text: Vexon Med goes beyond appearances to assess how your body performs.
shots.note: Flash on the bar downbeat (13.55 s). Body-composition assessment.

shots.name: SOLUTION b
shots.note: Panel drop on 15.73 s to the decision-making results screen.

shots.name: LOGO SLOT
shots.note: Fade to navy on 17.55 s; ends on the bar line at 19.37 s. Client adds the logo.
